evidence.detail: process_tournament() returns early if competition already exists — prevents re-scraping and duplicate match insertion for new tournaments
New API-based gatherling scraper introduced March 2021; idempotency check added that blocks re-processing already-stored competitions
insert_matches() has no within-scrape dedup; if Gatherling API returns the same match twice in one response, it would be inserted twice

triage.notes: Data for deck 41350 was manually cleaned up by bakert. Root cause of 151 byes is uncertain (old HTML scraper bug vs. Gatherling API returning duplicates). New API-based scraper prevents re-scraping but has no within-tournament dedup. bakert's comment 'underlying issue with a deck that has only a bye' is speculative and unspecified.
